entities.summary: Munio Gitai Weinraub was a Polish-born Jewish architect who was part of the Bauhaus movement in Israel. Throughout his 36-year career, he was responsible for the planning and construction of thousands of housing units, including workers' housing and private homes in and around Haifa.
